crossRefs.note: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;
When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his…
This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.
as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly…
But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

translations.web: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.
translations.bsb: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for believers, not for unbelievers.
translations.kjv: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
translations.asv: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to the unbelieving: but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to them that believe.
